questions.q: 時間軸圖上「一排等距的小點，兩端淡掉」代表哪一種動作？
opts: 反覆發生的事，例如每週一出貨
過去發生一次就結束的動作
正在進行中、從某時開始還沒結束、持續一段時間的動作
一路持續到句子提到的某個參考時刻為止的動作（完成式）
questions.exp: 一排小點是反覆，兩端淡掉表示以前這樣、以後也這樣，對應現在簡單式的習慣用法。

questions.q: The accounting manager ______ the expense reports every Friday afternoon.
questions.exp: every Friday afternoon 是習慣，用現在簡單式；主詞 the accounting manager 是第三人稱單數，加 -s。

questions.q: Mr. Wang ______ the conference call because his flight was delayed.
questions.exp: because his flight was delayed 是過去已發生的原因，錯過電話會議也是過去的事，用過去簡單式。

questions.q: We will ship your order as soon as the payment ______.
questions.exp: as soon as 帶出的時間子句講未來用現在簡單式，不用 will；payment 是單數，加 -s。

questions.q: The new branch manager ______ the staff three weeks ago.
questions.exp: ago 是過去明確的時間，配過去簡單式，不配現在完成式；meet 不規則，過去式是 met。

questions.q: A: There's no one at the front desk. B: I ______ the visitors to the meeting room myself.
questions.exp: 看到櫃台沒人才當場決定自己帶訪客過去，講話當下的決定用 will（'ll）。

questions.q: Which sentence uses be going to correctly to describe a plan made last week?
opts: The marketing team is going to launch the campaign next Monday.
The marketing team going to launch the campaign next Monday.
The marketing team is going to launched the campaign next Monday.
The marketing team are going launch the campaign next Monday.
questions.exp: be going to 要有 be（主詞 the marketing team 當一個單位用 is），to 後面接原形 launch。

questions.q: The shuttle bus to the convention center ______ every 30 minutes, according to the timetable.
questions.exp: according to the timetable 是時刻表，用現在簡單式；主詞單數加 -s。

questions.q: Which sentence has the adverb in the correct position?
opts: The director is usually in her office before eight.
The director in her office is usually before eight.
Usually is the director in her office before eight.
The director is in usually her office before eight.
questions.exp: be 動詞當主要動詞時，頻率副詞放在 be 後面：is usually。

questions.q: The client ______ our proposal yesterday, so we need to revise it.
questions.exp: yesterday 是過去，否定用 didn't＋原形 accept；過去只能標一次。
